name: Erev Rav (ערב רב)
notes: Added 2026-09-19 from the owner's link. Israel's main independent art magazine; its קול קורא category is a DEEP, CONTINUOUSLY-UPDATED open-calls archive — the single richest aggregator found so far, with roughly twenty listings visible on one page spanning Jun-Sep 2026 (Tel Aviv Museum video call, Beit HaGefen, Fresh Paint, Artis, Mekom LaOmanut, HaMekarer, JCU micro-grants, PHOTO IS:RAEL, Kubiya, Galeria K and more). HIGH PRIORITY for a scheduled re-check. Note it is an ARCHIVE listing, so entries include already-closed calls — each one must be date-checked before promotion, not bulk-imported.

name: PRTFL Magazine (מגזין פורטפוליו)
notes: Added 2026-09-19 from the owner's link. Israeli design/art/fashion magazine whose news stream carries קול קורא items (e.g. 'קול קורא: דיקן.ית לפקולטה לאמנויות, המדרשה' 18.9.2026; 'קול קורא: יריד צבע טרי 2027' 12.9.2026). needs_verification TRUE: unlike Erev Rav it has no dedicated open-calls category page, so calls are mixed into general editorial and there is no stable URL to poll. Weaker aggregator than src_098; leaning design/visual rather than dance/sound.

name: Ministry of Culture and Sport — Otzrot Tarbut database (משרד התרבות והספורט — אוצרותרבות)
notes: Added 2026-09-19 from the owner's link. Verified on gov.il: status explicitly 'פעיל' (active), published 19.07.2026. National programme building a digital database of quality cultural events that local authorities book from, across six fields — music, theatre and fringe, DANCE, cinema, literature, visual art/museums. Open to cultural bodies, institutions, NGOs, companies, licensed dealers, ensembles, CREATORS, performers, producers and content suppliers meeting the threshold conditions. Distinct from the existing SRC183 'Fund for Independent Creators — Ministry of Culture' row, which is a different programme from the same ministry. THE BROADEST-REACH ISRAELI OPPORTUNITY FOUND: national, active, and it names dance and music explicitly.

name: Karmiel Dance Festival (פסטיבל מחולות כרמיאל)
notes: Added 2026-09-19. NOTE ON THE LINK THE OWNER SENT: the kkl.org.il URL is NOT an artist open call — it is a KKL procurement notice declaring KKL's intent to enter a joint venture with the festival association, so it was deliberately not staged as an opportunity. The FESTIVAL ITSELF is a legitimate source: founded 1988 by Yonatan Karmon and Tirza Hodes, running 4-8 August 2026 across Karmiel with dozens of performances, and the KKL notice states it includes CHOREOGRAPHY AND FOLKLORE COMPETITIONS — which is where an artist-facing call would live. Those competitions' own call has not been found yet; website_url is inferred and UNVERIFIED. Karmiel added as a market by migration 0010.

name: KAN 11 — Israeli Public Broadcasting Corporation (תאגיד השידור הישראלי)
notes: Added 2026-09-19 from the owner's link. Runs a standing open-calls portal (kol-kore.kan.org.il). The specific call the owner sent is an open call for proposals to FILM AND BROADCAST MUSIC PERFORMANCES in 2026 for KAN 11 — see opp_stg_052. needs_verification TRUE: the call page renders as a submission form and no deadline or budget ceiling was visible on it. Note the eligibility shape — it addresses holders of filming and broadcast RIGHTS to existing or planned shows, i.e. producers and production companies more than individual performers.

name: Eshkolot Mutual Aid Fund (קרן אשכולות לעזרה הדדית)
notes: Added 2026-09-19 from the owner's link. Founded 1988 by Eshkolot (the Israeli performers' rights society) to give grants to PERFORMING ARTISTS IN FINANCIAL OR MEDICAL HARDSHIP. Verified on their own page. tier 3 and flagged here rather than promoted because the eligibility is narrow and conditional in a way most listings are not: applicants must be Eshkolot members WITH a royalty history (10/3/5-year average not below 700 ILS, or cumulative royalties above 30,000 ILS), and must be in demonstrated distress. Non-members cannot apply at all. It is a welfare safety net, not an open call — see the note on opp_stg_053.

name: Jerusalem Print Workshop (סדנת ההדפס ירושלים)
notes: Added 2026-09-19 from the owner's link. Founded in Jerusalem in 1974 by Arik Kilemnik as a home for traditional print techniques — etching, lithography, woodcut, screenprint. Runs the 'רזידנסי הדפס ירושלמי' residency jointly with Bezalel — see opp_stg_054. website_url is inferred and UNVERIFIED; the call was read on Bezalel's site, not the workshop's.
